newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Oil Co seeks compensation for bombings.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Oil Co seeks compensation for bombings.

text.p: Kuwait Oil Co, the state oil producer, is seeking about $10 million in compensation from 14 people convicted of bombing some of its facilities in 1986 and 1987, a newspaper reported on Sunday.
"KOC has filed a lawsuit against 14 citizens who were accused...of blowing up a number of oil installations," al-Anba daily said of the request for three million dinars ($10 million) in compensation.
In June 1987 a Kuwaiti court found 14 people guilty of involvement in the bombings, seen at the time as a protest against Kuwait's firm support for Iraq during its 1980-1988 war with Iran.
